newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Mirabell seen in HK$73 mln IPO - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Mirabell seen in HK$73 mln IPO - sources.

text.p: Shoe distributor Mirabell International Holdings Ltd is expected to issue 60 million new shares at HK$1.22 per share, market sources said on Monday.

Market sources said the weighted average and fully diluted prospective price to earnings multiples are expected to be 6.1 times and 7.1 times respectively and its market capitalisation is about HK$290 million.
The dividend yield is expected to be 6.00 percent and its net asset value is HK$0.516 per share, they said.
Market sources said no listing schedule was immediately available to the market.
Nikko Securities is expected to be the sponsor of the issue and Tai Fook Securities the co-sponsor, sources said.

Among the expected HK$63 million net proceeds, HK$19 million is expected to be used to expand its distribution network in Hong Kong, HK$15 million to fund purchase of property for warehouse use, HK$10 million to repay bank loans and the other HK$19 million for general working capital, the sources said.
Mirabell which has about 40 distribution outlets in Hong Kong, is eyeing the China market, an analyst who attended the company's presentation on Monday said.
The company had posted higher profit of HK$24.9 million for the year ended February 28, 1996, up from HK$23.7 million in 1995 and HK$18.1 million in 1994.
Turnover also rose to HK$283.2 million in 1996, from HK$195.6 million in 1995 and HK$158.8 million in 1994, the sources said.
They said Mirabell made a profit of HK$13 million in the four months to June 30, 1996, on turnover of HK$106.4 million.
